title: The Twin Aegis Canon
summary: A canon of two aegis held in step that ends in a mutual guard no single blow can open.

title: Treatise of the Paired Mind-Shield
summary: A treatise on a shield for the mind in two halves that close on a hostile soul that touches it.

title: Hawk and Azure Mantle Mastery
summary: A mastery of the high mantle that sees all blows from above and meets each at the right height.

title: The Basin Mind Foundation
summary: A foundation that gathers hostile force into the soul like water in a basin and lets it drain harmlessly.

title: River-Course Ward Canon
summary: A canon of a ward that runs like a river so that attacks are carried off along its course.

title: The Oath Against Intrusion
summary: A canon of the oath sworn against all intrusion that ends in a sworn refusal no will can force.

title: Plateau Mind Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the mind as a high level plain where every approaching force is seen from far away.

title: The Wind-Sworn Calm Canon
summary: A canon of the calm sworn to the wind that lets a storm of will go by without a mark.

title: Mastery of the Held Bearing
summary: A mastery of the bearing held in the soul against any pull of a greater will.

title: Treatise of the Unbowed Oath
summary: A treatise on the oath that no force can bend and the soul that carries it unharmed through ruin.
